identity.name: EMAIL — Malicious Attachment (macro / ISO / HTML-smuggling) via Proofpoint TAP + Microsoft 365
identity.summary: The email_emitter emits a burst of Proofpoint TAP messagesBlocked events carrying a weaponized attachment (threatType=attachment, sha256 set) for one recipient, then proves the same attachment logic fires over the Microsoft 365 EmailEvents shape. Cortex XSIAM raises a malware-attachment alert on the recipient mailbox and stitches the attachment hash to the endpoint follow-on.
identity.description: Spearphishing-attachment delivery (T1566.001) carries a weaponized file — a macro-enabled document, ISO/IMG container, or HTML-smuggling page — to the victim mailbox. This card drives CortexSim's email_emitter to POST a burst of Proofpoint TAP messagesBlocked events (threatsInfoMap classification=malware, threatType=attachment, sha256 set) for ada.lovelace into the email log collector, then repeats the pattern in Microsoft 365 / Defender for Office 365 EmailEvents shape. Detection is email-log analytics in Cortex XSIAM: an XQL rule over the proofpoint_tap_raw dataset windows blocked-attachment events per recipient and alerts when a malware-classified attachment is delivered, with a parallel query proving the same resolves over msft_o365. A correlation rule pivots the attachment sha256 into the endpoint xdr_data file/process stream to confirm whether the payload reached an endpoint.

prerequisites.description: CortexSim email_emitter EAL plugin registered and an authorized email log collector endpoint reachable.
prerequisites.check_command: python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli describe email_emitter | jq -e '.eal_targets | length > 0'

prerequisites.description: Cortex XSIAM ingesting the Proofpoint TAP (proofpoint_tap_raw) and Microsoft 365 (msft_o365) email datasets.

payload.code:
# Emit a malicious-attachment message burst (Proofpoint TAP then Microsoft 365 shape).
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/email-002.yml --live
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/email-002-m365.yml --live

expected_artifacts.description: A burst of blocked inbound messages carrying a malware-classified attachment for one recipient.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: classification = "malware" and threatsInfoMap.threatType = "attachment" for one recipient

expected_artifacts.description: Weaponized attachment identified by its sha256 in the email telemetry, pivotable into the endpoint file stream.

iocs.context: Sender domain of the malicious-attachment message emitted by email_emitter (_PATTERN_INDICATORS["malicious_attachment"].sender_domain). Appears in the Proofpoint TAP senderDomain / M365 SenderMailFromDomain field.
SHA-256 of the weaponized ISO attachment (email_emitter malicious_attachment indicators). Appears in threatsInfoMap.sha256 / M365 SHA256 and is the pivot into the endpoint xdr_data file stream.
Attachment filename of the malware lure (email_emitter malicious_attachment indicators). An ISO container is a common HTML-smuggling / mark-of-the-web bypass delivery.

biocs.name: EMAIL-002 Pre-Flight email_emitter Metadata Visible
biocs.description: Pre-flight: email_emitter metadata visible to operator. Confirms the EAL plugin is registered and exposes EMAIL targets before any events are emitted, so a null result means a harness fault rather than a detection miss.
biocs.logic:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter messageType in ("messagesBlocked", "messagesDelivered", "clicksPermitted") or _raw_log contains "email_emitter"
| comp count() as preflight_events by recipient
| filter preflight_events >= 0

xql_queries.name: EMAIL-002 Malicious Attachment Blocked By TAP
xql_queries.query:
// [MODEL: dataset=proofpoint_tap_raw, content_id="ProofpointTAP"]
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter classification = "malware" and messageType = "messagesBlocked"
| comp count() as malware_events, values(sha256) as hashes, values(threat) as files by recipient, sender
| filter malware_events >= 1
| fields recipient, sender, malware_events, hashes, files

xql_queries.name: EMAIL-002 Malicious Attachment Microsoft 365 EmailEvents Shape
xql_queries.query:
dataset = msft_o365
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter RecordType = "EmailEvents" and ThreatTypes contains "Malware" and AttachmentCount >= 1
| comp count() as malware_events, values(SHA256) as hashes, values(FileName) as files by RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress
| filter malware_events >= 1
| fields RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress, malware_events, hashes, files

correlation_rules.name: Malicious Attachment Delivered Then Endpoint Detonation — Email to Endpoint Stitch
correlation_rules.logic: XQL(EMAIL-002 Malicious Attachment Blocked By TAP) OR XQL(EMAIL-002 Malicious Attachment Microsoft 365 EmailEvents Shape) FOLLOWED_BY xdr_data file or process with the same sha256 for the recipient within 2h

analytics_modules: Cortex XSIAM Email Analytics — Malware-classified attachment delivered per recipient
Cortex XSIAM Correlation — Attachment hash to endpoint file/process pivot

products.evidence_query: dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw | filter classification = "malware" | comp count() by recipient | filter _count >= 1
Correlation CR-EMAIL-0002 pivots the attachment sha256 into the endpoint file/process stream for the recipient.

use_cases.name: Malicious Attachment Detection
use_cases.description: Detect a malware-classified attachment delivered to a recipient across both Proofpoint TAP and Microsoft 365 email log shapes, pivoting the hash into the endpoint stream.

test_cases.objective: A burst of blocked malware-attachment messages for one recipient raises a malware-attachment alert.
preconditions: Cortex XSIAM ingesting proofpoint_tap_raw and msft_o365 datasets.
email_emitter authorized against the lab collector.
steps: Observe the malware-attachment alert per recipient in the Cortex console.
success_criteria: XQL `EMAIL-002 Malicious Attachment Blocked By TAP` returns >= 1 row.
XQL `EMAIL-002 Malicious Attachment Microsoft 365 EmailEvents Shape` returns >= 1 row.

test_cases.objective: The attachment hash pivots into the endpoint file/process stream.
success_criteria: Correlation `CR-EMAIL-0002` ties the attachment sha256 to the recipient endpoint follow-on under one incident.

preventive_controls: Detonate attachments in a sandbox before delivery and block container/macro file types by policy.
Enforce mark-of-the-web propagation and block ISO/IMG auto-mount for email-sourced files.
Strip active content (macros) from inbound Office documents.
detection_engineering: Window blocked-attachment events per recipient over the Proofpoint TAP dataset and alert on malware classifications.
Normalize Proofpoint TAP and Microsoft 365 EmailEvents attachment telemetry into one schema.
Pivot the attachment sha256 into the endpoint file/process stream to confirm reach.
